issues.description: The problem statement (and task text) requires ExcellenceLand to have a private attribute 'rides' of type List<Ride>, but the solution implementation declares 'public List<Ride> rides;'. This visibility mismatch contradicts the specification and the instruction to provide private attributes with public getters, which may confuse students about the intended encapsulation and what they must implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the 'rides' field in ExcellenceLand to private (private List<Ride> rides;) and provide a public getter (public List<Ride> getRides()) as required by the exercise description. Ensure the constructor and getter names/signatures match the specification.
